coverage: Broad release-by-release adoption inventory: C++98 language/library baseline; representative C++03 TC1 corrections; C++11 language inventory and library families; C++14–26 language features and adopted library papers from LLVM. Includes refinements, removals and selected retroactive defect corrections under the revision whose source inventory lists them. Grouped papers are not individual overloads or every core/library defect report. Technical Specifications and reverted proposals are excluded. C++26 is technically finalized but remains labeled draft until ISO publication is confirmed. Reference entries are separate from your personal notes.
